title: One-stage vanishing of an affine module section
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R a ring diagram, c a limiting cone of its inverse spectra with affine vertex, i ≤ j, f : Xi → Spec(Ri), G a quasi-coherent module on Xj = Xi × Spec(Rj), U an affine open of Xi, and y a section of G over its inverse image [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change, pqf-def-coherent]. Supply tensor-pullback/pushforward adjunctions to the limit and each stage ≥ j [def-pc-module-pullback, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. If the limit unit kills y, some stage l ≥ j has unit killing y. No finite presentation or conclusion about all later stages is asserted.

source.place: Limits, Lemma limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR (3), first proof; Algebra Tag 05N7 (3), finite-generator vanishing argument; shorter tensor route: Algebra Tag 05LI (1), lemma-module-map-property-in-colimit

proof.text: Construct the actual upper-tail diagram of chart section rings. The new chart-colimit theorem identifies the limit chart ring as its colimit. The affine comparison of module pullback sections sends 1 tensor y to the canonical pullback unit and is injective. A proved private helper compares arbitrary supplied units with the canonical unit via leftAdjointUniq, and invertible section restrictions identify equal inverse-image opens. Transport the zero tensor from the chart-ring cocone to the chosen ring colimit, apply the zero clause of directedColimitBaseChangeElementwise to 1 tensor y at j, and use map_one to identify the image at the resulting stage with 1 tensor y. The affine comparison reflects zero there, giving the conclusion for the supplied stage adjunction.

theorem section_affine_open_zero_at_stage
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (G : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules)
    (hG_qc : G.IsQuasicoherent)
    (U : Xi.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (y : Γ(G, (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) ⁻¹ᵁ U))
    (adjlim : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      (baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))) ⊣
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
          (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
          (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))))
    (adjstage : ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let g := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward g)
    (hy : (adjlim.unit.app G).val.app
      (op ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) ⁻¹ᵁ U)) y = 0) :
    ∃ (l : I) (hjl : j ≤ l),
      ((adjstage l hjl).unit.app G).val.app
        (op ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) ⁻¹ᵁ U)) y = 0
